text: EmberStake can already take $EMBER in and pay it back out -- but it can't pay anyone ETH yet. This lesson adds the rewards accounting.
distributeRewards() takes ETH from Cinder Labs' trusted fee collector and splits it across stakers, proportional to how much each one has staked.
claimRewards() looks up what a staker is owed, sends the ETH, then clears their balance -- a clean, natural withdrawal pattern.
Both functions pass a local sanity check with real test accounts, and Vivian signs off: the rewards side of EmberStake is functionally complete.
Next: writing the Hardhat test suite that proves staking, withdrawing, distribution, and claims all work exactly as intended.
